text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(The chocolate is sweet, the sponge is
light—just as it should be. Whipped for
nine minutes, as required for these
ingredients. I seem to have got my sense
for this back.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The sachertorte is complete,
along with all
the finishing touches. This
should be a
worthy entry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few hours earlier...

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The illustrious Spring Choice Chocolatier
Contest is now accepting
entries!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This event is part of the Chocolate
Festival sponsored by Spring
Confectioners, who
strive to produce "the peak of
confection"!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Patissiers from all around the world
gather to take part in this popular
chocolate
exhibition! Expect to see a giant dessert
buffet and live baking performances!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With contenders from schools all across
the country, this contest aims to find the
best student confectioners!
Entries are first come, first
served! As representative of our
academy, I urge you to consider applying!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Okay, entry application received.
Contestants must enter in pairs, so
once
you have a partner, we can complete your
entry.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
By the way,
I've heard that you'll be taking
over your family's bakery once you
graduate. Is that what motivated you to
apply?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well,
not exactly... Spring Confectioners is
a client of ours, so I
wanted to enter as a
way to express my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
As such,
I do not take my entrance lightly.
I intend to bring attention to this year's
contest in a way that will be remembered
for years to come. That's how determined I
am.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I see! Hehe, that sounds like some great
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Well then, please let me know
if another applicant steps
forward—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. Is this where I should submit
my application for the Spring
Choice
Chocolatier Contest?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I'd like to begin our first
strategy meeting for the Spring
Choice
Chocolatier Contest. Here is the agenda.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
First, let's go over the rules. In this
contest, each team prepares a

theme-based recipe in advance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then on the day of the contest, each team
bakes their recipe. The time limit is five
hours. Entries are in pairs. During the
preparation period, each team is allowed
to call on up to three helpers.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Next, I will explain the procedure for
placing an order for uniforms.
The
academy will provide uniforms for both
participants.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Entrants must select a design from the
catalog, input a size, and
submit the order
to Tazuna within seven days.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. The uniforms will be a welcome
addition. They're
incredibly suitable for
efficient movement while baking.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's discuss the theme and how we
shall proceed. This year, the
objective is to
create a school-themed chocolate dessert.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's an abstract idea,
which means there are
many ways it could be interpreted. In
other words, brainstorming as many ideas
as possible
will be crucial to our success.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I believe it would be most efficient to
start by finding helpers,
gathering ideas, and
testing them as we work on the design.
What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Calculating... The method suggested is the
most efficient. I have no
objections.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. After a three-minute
break, let's check our training
schedules
for openings and arrange future meetings.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This isn't part of the meeting but... is
baking a hobby of yours?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It differs slightly from a hobby.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
After five tries, my sponge cake is still
13% less bouncy than
anticipated.
Status—failed. Improvement of skills is
necessary.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Make friend chocolates for Valentine's!"

"Express your gratitude with fabulous
chocolates!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice, Bakushin O, Flower... There are
several people who I would like
to present
them to.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Searching for a prompt and effective
training method... The Spring
Choice
Chocolatier Contest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In summary, I entered in order to upgrade
my skills. The desired
outcome: a level
high enough to win in a competition.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, my objective is to win the
highest award of excellence at
the Spring
Choice Chocolatier Contest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I see... That's a relief.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A relief? Why?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The reason I applied is to repay a
favor to
Spring Confectioners. I'm
aiming for the
first prize, and nothing less will do.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In team contests, success rides on sharing
the same goal. So, I look forward to
working with you. Let's reach the "peak of
confection"
together.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Purple violas and pink pansies... hehe. I
hope the girls will like how I
planted them
together!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Flower?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine!
The planter's just a bit too big,
so I couldn't see my feet.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Oh...
Why don't you let us carry it for you!
You want it over there,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, it's okay—

text_block_list.name: Flower's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
It's no problem. We'd rather do this than
just let you fall down again!
You're still
small, so don't worry about it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I was trying to do it on my own, but
someone helped me out again...)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Flower—identity confirmed. Hello. I have a
favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Would you be willing to help me in the
Spring Choice Chocolatier
Contest?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You want some help? Um... are you sure
you want me, though?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Please lend me your cooking
skills.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well then, it's my pleasure to help you
out! I'll give it everything I've
got. I'm glad
to join your team!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Count me in too! Just leave
everything to me!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Both have expressed their willingness and
availability to assist us.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's great to hear. Thank you both for
joining us. I have also invited
one more
member to help us get a variety of ideas.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heeey. If I help, I get to nosh on a bunch
of sweets, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well then, we look forward to working
with all of you, even if it's only
for a short
time.
